heroTitle: Get the discovery or engineering strategy right before you commit a program.
heroDescription: Short, focused engagements to pressure-test a target, biomarker, protein/enzyme design, strain-engineering, or pipeline plan before it becomes a multi-year program.

steps.title: Scoping session
steps.text: A working session to understand your current pipeline, data, and constraints.

steps.title: Architecture review
steps.text: An assessment of what to keep, what to replace, and where the risk actually is.

steps.title: Recommendation
steps.text: A written plan you can act on with us, another vendor, or your own team.
